verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Brex exposes a broad API surface with a Postman workspace for 'all Brex APIs' and third-party integration recipes (Pipedream, Workato) that issue virtual cards and set spend limits/monthly limits, plus a budgets/spend-limits API. However, there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated Cards API (create/lock/update card controls) in the evidence pack — no cards_api.md or explicit lock/update-controls endpoints are cited, only inferred usage via third-party automation platforms. Missing for 10: a documented Cards API reference showing create-with-limit, lock/freeze, and update-controls endpoints, and any independent hands-on confirmation of programmatic card lifecycle management.
